items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Should he have you and Punch and Toka? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, he had me, Punch, Georgia Boyd, and Charlie Moore. And Jimmy Johnson.

ctx.x: Years ago, Allen, Allen had his own band. But old old, he broke up. But he was into demand. Everybody knew him. And whenever he would get his job. He was smart. He would go hard to tuxedo man. Everybody would always want to play. He would always want to play. Sometimes they'd sell some bands, an Arnold's band. He would hire the whole band. Yeah, he was smart. That always kept him with a good band. Mm-hmm.
What about Jack Carey's band? Who did Jack have in his band? Should he have you and Punch and Toka?

Well, he had me, Punch, Georgia Boyd, and Charlie Moore. And Jimmy Johnson. You worked on the Jimmy Johnson. Mm-hmm. That was a pay-polling band. But he didn't have a sick piece. And whenever he'd get a job, whether that's been on, he'd always hire horses. Horses, huh?
